versos.grego: Συμεὼν Πέτρος δοῦλος καὶ ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῖς ἰσότιμον ἡμῖν λαχοῦσιν πίστιν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·

controles.web: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
controles.kjv: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
controles.livre: Simão Pedro, servo e apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, aos que obtiveram conosco a igualmente preciosa fé pela justiça de nosso Deus e Salvador Jesus Cristo;

versos.grego: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν.

controles.web: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
controles.kjv: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
controles.livre: Graça e paz vos seja multiplicada pelo conhecimento de Deus, e de Jesus nosso Senhor.

versos.grego: Ὡς τὰ πάντα ἡμῖν τῆς θείας δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ τὰ πρὸς ζωὴν καὶ εὐσέβειαν δεδωρημένης διὰ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ καλέσαντος ἡμᾶς ἰδίᾳ δόξῃ καὶ ἀρετῇ,

controles.web: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue;
controles.kjv: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
controles.livre: Como seu divino poder ele tem nos dado tudo o que pertence à vida e à devoção divina, por meio do conhecimento daquele que nos chamou à glória e virtude;

versos.grego: δι’ ὧν τὰ τίμια καὶ μέγιστα ἡμῖν ἐπαγγέλματα δεδώρηται, ἵνα διὰ τούτων γένησθε θείας κοινωνοὶ φύσεως, ἀποφυγόντες τῆς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ φθορᾶς.

controles.web: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
controles.kjv: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
controles.livre: Pelas quais nos são dadas grandíssimas e preciosas promessas, para que por meio delas sejais participantes da natureza divina, tendo escapado da corrupção que há no mundo pelo mau desejo.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸ τοῦτο δὲ σπουδὴν πᾶσαν παρεισενέγκαντες ἐπιχορηγήσατε ἐν τῇ πίστει ὑμῶν τὴν ἀρετήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἀρετῇ τὴν γνῶσιν,

controles.web: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
controles.kjv: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
controles.livre: E por isso mesmo, pondo todo o empenho, acrescentai a vossa fé virtude; e à virtude, conhecimento;

versos.grego: ἐν δὲ τῇ γνώσει τὴν ἐγκράτειαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐγκρατείᾳ τὴν ὑπομονήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ὑπομονῇ τὴν εὐσέβειαν,

controles.web: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control patience; and in patience godliness;
controles.kjv: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
controles.livre: E ao conhecimento, domínio próprio; e ao domínio próprio, paciência; e à paciência, devoção divina;

versos.grego: ἐν δὲ τῇ εὐσεβείᾳ τὴν φιλαδελφίαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ τὴν ἀγάπην.

controles.web: and in godliness brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
controles.kjv: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
controles.livre: E à devoção divina, amor fraternal; e ao amor fraternal, amor.

versos.grego: ταῦτα γὰρ ὑμῖν ὑπάρχοντα καὶ πλεονάζοντα οὐκ ἀργοὺς οὐδὲ ἀκάρπους καθίστησιν εἰς τὴν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐπίγνωσιν·

controles.web: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to be not idle nor unfruitful to the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Porque se em vós existirem e abundarem estas coisas, elas não vos deixarão ociosos nem estéreis no conhecimento de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: ᾧ γὰρ μὴ πάρεστιν ταῦτα, τυφλός ἐστιν μυωπάζων, λήθην λαβὼν τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ τῶν πάλαι αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτιῶν.

controles.web: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
controles.kjv: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
controles.livre: Porque aquele em quem não há estas coisas é cego, nada vendo de longe, tendo se esquecido da purificação de seus antigos pecados.

versos.grego: διὸ μᾶλλον, ἀδελφοί, σπουδάσατε βεβαίαν ὑμῶν τὴν κλῆσιν καὶ ἐκλογὴν ποιεῖσθαι· ταῦτα γὰρ ποιοῦντες οὐ μὴ πταίσητέ ποτε.

controles.web: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
controles.kjv: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
controles.livre: Portanto, irmãos, procurai ainda mais confirmar vosso chamamento e escolha da parte de Deus ; porque fazendo isso nunca tropeçareis.

versos.grego: οὕτως γὰρ πλουσίως ἐπιχορηγηθήσεται ὑμῖν ἡ εἴσοδος εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον βασιλείαν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Porque assim vos será abundantemente fornecida a entrada no reino eterno de nosso Senhor e Salvador Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Διὸ μελλήσω ἀεὶ ὑμᾶς ὑπομιμνῄσκειν περὶ τούτων, καίπερ εἰδότας καὶ ἐστηριγμένους ἐν τῇ παρούσῃ ἀληθείᾳ.

controles.web: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them, and are established in the present truth.
controles.kjv: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
controles.livre: Por isso eu não deixarei de sempre vos relembrar destas coisas, ainda que as saibais, e estejais firmes na verdade presente.

versos.grego: δίκαιον δὲ ἡγοῦμαι, ἐφ’ ὅσον εἰμὶ ἐν τούτῳ τῷ σκηνώματι, διεγείρειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ὑπομνήσει,

controles.web: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you;
controles.kjv: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
controles.livre: E eu considero justo, enquanto eu estiver neste tabernáculo, de vos despertar com relembranças;

versos.grego: εἰδὼς ὅτι ταχινή ἐστιν ἡ ἀπόθεσις τοῦ σκηνώματός μου, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐδήλωσέν μοι·

controles.web: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
controles.kjv: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
controles.livre: Sabendo que breve está a saída do meu meu tabernáculo, conforme também nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo tem revelado a mim.

versos.grego: σπουδάσω δὲ καὶ ἑκάστοτε ἔχειν ὑμᾶς μετὰ τὴν ἐμὴν ἔξοδον τὴν τούτων μνήμην ποιεῖσθαι.

controles.web: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
controles.kjv: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
controles.livre: Mas também procurarei que depois de minha partida vós sejais capazes de ter lembrança destas coisas.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ σεσοφισμένοις μύθοις ἐξακολουθήσαντες ἐγνωρίσαμεν ὑμῖν τὴν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δύναμιν καὶ παρουσίαν, ἀλλ’ ἐπόπται γενηθέντες τῆς ἐκείνου μεγαλειότητος.

controles.web: For we did not follow cunningly devised fables, when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
controles.kjv: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
controles.livre: Porque nós não vos anunciamos o poder e vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seguindo mitos criados pela inteligência humana, mas sim como testemunhas oculares de sua grandiosidade.

versos.grego: λαβὼν γὰρ παρὰ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν φωνῆς ἐνεχθείσης αὐτῷ τοιᾶσδε ὑπὸ τῆς μεγαλοπρεποῦς δόξης Ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός μου οὗτός ἐστιν, εἰς ὃν ἐγὼ εὐδόκησα,—

controles.web: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
controles.kjv: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
controles.livre: Porque de Deus Pai ele recebeu honra e glória, tendo sido lhe enviada tal voz de magnífica glória: Este é meu amado Filho, em quem me agrado.

versos.grego: καὶ ταύτην τὴν φωνὴν ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐνεχθεῖσαν σὺν αὐτῷ ὄντες ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ὄρει.

controles.web: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
controles.kjv: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
controles.livre: E nós ouvimos esta voz enviada do Céu, estando nós com ele no santo monte.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔχομεν βεβαιότερον τὸν προφητικὸν λόγον, ᾧ καλῶς ποιεῖτε προσέχοντες ὡς λύχνῳ φαίνοντι ἐν αὐχμηρῷ τόπῳ, ἕως οὗ ἡμέρα διαυγάσῃ καὶ φωσφόρος ἀνατείλῃ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν·

controles.web: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns, and the morning star arises in your hearts:
controles.kjv: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
controles.livre: E temos a muito confiável palavra dos profetas; a qual vós fazeis bem ao prestardes atenção, como a uma luz que ilumina em lugar escuro, até que o dia clareie e a estrela da manhã se levante em vossos corações.

versos.grego: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες, ὅτι πᾶσα προφητεία γραφῆς ἰδίας ἐπιλύσεως οὐ γίνεται·

controles.web: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
controles.kjv: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
controles.livre: Sabendo primeiramente isto: que nenhuma profecia da Escritura é de interpretação particular.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ θελήματι ἀνθρώπου ἠνέχθη προφητεία ποτέ, ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου φερόμενοι ἐλάλησαν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἄνθρωποι.

controles.web: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
controles.kjv: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: Porque a profecia jamais foi produzida pela vontade humana, mas homens falaram da parte de Deus conduzidos pelo Espírito Santo.
